notes: Find short release highlights in Settings → What’s new.
Open Older updates to see earlier changes.
Everyone can manage the Cut List; admins can undo changes.
Upcoming cuts now appear on the Dashboard.
See today’s and total website visits in Settings.
No ads. Offline use is not counted.
Inventory now includes mills, full sheets, and leftover material.
Search stock by material or size, and record cuts from Inventory.
Anyone can report material cuts and broken mills.
Admins can undo reports in Settings.
Set cut priorities and move jobs up or down.
Switch between planned order and priority-first views.
Pin important notes and plan jobs in the Cut List.
Record a material cut and save its smaller leftover.
Read and search shop reminders in Notes.
Notes are included in backups and offline downloads.
Click any mill row to change its details.
Search results and selected mill details now stay in sync.
Removed Location from tool Inventory; saved data is preserved.
Started a versioned change log for releases.
